interface_level_gaps.consequence: The number that decides whether two independent measurements agree is not part of the interface as read, so the acceptance threshold is not reviewable from the boundary itself.

interface_level_gaps.gap: The tolerance each element applies is named in the source but its value and configuration point are not stated in any header this record transcribes.

providing_module.name: Plausibility module
providing_module.role: Compares a base measurement against its redundant counterpart and returns whether the two agree to within a configured tolerance. On agreement it also writes the averaged value out, so the caller receives both a verdict and a value from one call. It is a pure function of its inputs: it reads no database entry and publishes nothing itself.
